headline: Kality Furniture PLC (Rank 5, 67 pts) — Equipment request exceeds €12,000 cap; strong management and market reach.
whyThisRank: Kality Furniture PLC places 5th with 67 points on the investment readiness track, trailing Misrak Foods PLC (71 points) by 4 points. Lower points on job creation potential (5/25) offset full marks in management capacity and market reach.
justification: Kality Furniture PLC achieved 67 out of 100 available points and meets all basic eligibility criteria as an 8-year-old private limited company. The evaluation registered full marks for international market reach, expected intervention results, management capacity, female ownership (40%), and current headcount. However, under track 7b (investment readiness), the company received only 5 of 25 points based on a 16-job addition plan. Furthermore, a compliance contradiction was identified as the requested equipment total of 3,780,000 ETB (approximately €22,909) exceeds the maximum sequa grant cap of €12,000.
strengths: Achieved maximum points for intervention results (20/20), international market reach (5/5), and management capacity (5/5).
Strong ownership score with 40% female ownership (5/5 points) and an established baseline of 22 employees (5/5 points).
Solid social and environmental impact reporting (8/10 points).
watchouts: Equipment request totaling 3,780,000 ETB (≈ €22,909) exceeds the sequa contribution cap of €12,000.
Scored low on job creation potential under track 7b, receiving 5 out of 25 points for 16 planned new positions.
Youth employee ratio is relatively low at 18.2% (2/5 points).
